title: Electric field strength
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be E = 3mg/(2q) or equivalent.

title: Acceleration of ball A
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must include magnitude a_A = g/2 and direction upward.

title: Acceleration of ball B
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (3) must include magnitude a_B = g/2 and direction downward.

title: Pre-break force balance
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply Newton's second law to the two-ball system before the string breaks to relate electric force, weight, and constant velocity.

title: Post-break free-body analysis
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply Newton's second law separately to each ball after the string breaks, considering only electric force and weight.

title: Sign/direction consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if signs for forces or accelerations are inconsistent with chosen coordinate system or if directions are mislabeled.

title: Mass or charge mix-up
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the masses (m vs 2m) or the charges are incorrectly substituted into the force equations.

title: Unit consideration
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may include correct units (N/C, m/s²) for the final answers.
